cohort: This study included 92 patients diagnosed with cervical cancer during pregnancy, with data collected from Nanfang Hospital, Tongji Hospital, and PubMed case reports (1961-2019).
finding: Tumor size was an independent predictor of survival in patients with cervical cancer during pregnancy, and pregnancy negatively impacted prognosis, highlighting the need for personalized treatment approaches.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at diagnosis: 11+/-3 weeks for those who terminated pregnancy, 35+/-2 weeks at delivery for those who continued pregnancy
